2014_spells.skill-empowerment.fullDescri: Using 1 action, you touch one willing creature and give it expertise in one skill of its choice; until the spell ends, the creature doubles its proficiency bonus for any ability check it makes with that skill. Your magic deepens a creature's understanding of its own talent; You must choose a creature with at least one skill proficiency. You touch one willing creature and give it expertise in one skill of its choice; until the spell ends, the creature doubles its proficiency bonus for any ability check it makes with that skill; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
